description: Search multiple promoted public-data sources for the same organization/topic, normalize the records, rank actionability with a deterministic reason-bearing heuristic, and surface only conservative cross-source identity candidates. Scores are not probabilities and name matches are never called verified identity.

keyword.description: Organization/topic name to search across promoted sources

limit_per_source.description: Maximum rows requested from each source before tier caps

source_ids.description: Optional promoted source ids; defaults to all currently searchable Wave 1 public-data sources

name: fedwatch_signal_search
